io.name: d
io.description: Data input sampled on the rising edge of clk.

io.name: r
io.description: Active-high synchronous reset; when high at the rising edge, q is reset to 0.

io.name: q
io.description: Registered output; captures d on rising edge unless r is high, in which case it becomes 0.

functional_summary.overview: Simple 1-bit D flip-flop with active-high synchronous reset. On each rising edge of clk, q updates to d unless r is high, in which case q is set to 0.
rules: On posedge clk: if r == 1, q <= 0; else q <= d.
Reset is synchronous: r only affects q at a rising clock edge.
q holds its value between rising edges of clk.
Output q reflects the sampled value one cycle after the corresponding input edge.
